        for(int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            if(s[i] == 'X') {
                s[i] = x;
            }
        }
        if(s[0] == '0') {
            return 0;
        }
        int ans = 1;
        boolean first = true;
        for(int i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
            if(s[i] == '_') {
                ans *= i == 0 ? 9 : 10;
            } else if(s[i] == 'X' && first) {
                ans *= i == 0 ? 9 : 10;
                first = false;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
    private static boolean canReplace(char[] s, char a, char b) {
        if(s[s.length-2] >= '0' && s[s.length-2] <= '9' && s[s.length-2] != a) {

        }
        if(s[s.length-1] >= '0' && s[s.length-1] <= '9' && s[s.length-1] != b) {
            return false;
        }
        if(s[s.length-2] == 'X' && s[s.length-1] == 'X' && a != b) {
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
